notes.title: Ultra Imposer Releasing Soon!
notes.notes:
Get your thumbs ready. Ultra Imposer is releasing 05/20/22 at 12:00am EST.

It's been a while since I've posted, but Ultra Imposer is very nearly upon us and It's seen a change or two since its demo build.  

[list]
[*] Gamepad support has been dropped for the more friendly tracked-controller pointer.  This allowed for more focus on game-play balance and has also proven to be the more fun option.

[*] The Imposer Drone now fires repeatedly for a short time with a single trigger-push stopping just before engaging lock-on targeting.
[/list]

I really appreciate the feedback I received from the demo, folks!  It helped to build a better game. 

I hope this post finds you all well. 

flapjax out! <3

[previewyoutube=1403BVtbgp4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Taking Control
notes.notes:
Take control with more options, human!

I've heard you! Now we can use a tracked controller to point with in the latest update to the Ultra Imposer Demo.  Choose from three control options:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39265163/52db9ff5666d7c875d9490024f782acda07372f0.png[/img]

[b][i]Standard:[/i][/b]
Standard controls use the right tracked controller to point the ship's cursor.

[b][i]Gamepad:[/i][/b]
Plug in an xbox or ps4/ps5 controller and take aim with the right control stick.  This option is selected automatically when a gamepad is detected.

[b][i]Traditional:[/i][/b]
Want to play Ultra Imposer like a gamepad with your tracked controllers?  This is your option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39265163/48194821e426a51d865debf7a0e6462d41d4fea1.png[/img]



I hope you have a chance to try the update and it provides a better experience for everyone.  I'm listening and hope that I'll get more feedback.  Thanks all for playing!

[hr][/hr]
Ultra Imposer is a sci-fi action shooter on-rails virtual reality game featuring multiple Imposer Drones, over ten levels of action, and unique boss battles! Gear up and destroy the infection in all of its forms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39265163/fbfd8a4d123da4c38435b66d133354a14b97d20a.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
The year is 2034 and a dark infection has taken hold of societies' backbone, our virtual space. Its grasp on the realm has barricaded our ability to interface with our systems and we have lost all control.

Civilization is at collapse, but all is not lost. An indie dev has engineered a final hope for us to reclaim what is ours, a weapon that can penetrate the barrier:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39265163/a2cc024d42ad9949212a82b943a02468ca0d9656.png[/img]

[i]You must impose this dark enemy and eradicate it from the system, human. Pilot the Ultra Imposer drone and eradicate the enemy army with your blasters or lock-on to multiple enemy targets to unleash a barrage of seeker missile destruction.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
